description: This file defines the HttpRequestModifier class, which provides methods to modify various parts of an HTTP request such as path, query parameters, headers, and cookies. It includes methods for setting regex-based path modifications and managing request components.

classes.name: HttpRequestModifier
classes.description: A class for modifying HTTP request components such as path, query parameters, headers, and cookies.

methods.name: requestModifier
methods.description: Static factory method to create a new HttpRequestModifier instance.

methods.name: withPath (String regex, String substitution)
methods.description: Sets the path modification using a regex pattern and substitution string.

methods.name: withQueryStringParameters (Parameters add, Parameters replace, List<String> remove)
methods.description: Sets query parameters to add, replace, or remove.

methods.name: withQueryStringParameters (List<Parameter> add, List<Parameter> replace, List<String> remove)
methods.description: Sets query parameters with lists of Parameter objects to add or replace, and list of strings to remove.

methods.name: withHeaders (List<Header> add, List<Header> replace, List<String> remove)
methods.description: Sets headers with lists of Header objects to add or replace, and list of strings to remove.

methods.name: withCookies (List<Cookie> add, List<Cookie> replace, List<String> remove)
methods.description: Sets cookies with lists of Cookie objects to add or replace, and list of strings to remove.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Overrides Object.equals to compare HttpRequestModifier instances based on path, query parameters, headers, and cookies.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Computes and caches the hash code based on path, query parameters, headers, and cookies.
